Copy the master model's proportions and color palette exactly. Full complete character, no chair.

His shoulders and upper back lie low down, torso reclined nearly flat, face looking upward toward the viewer; BOTH knees bent with BOTH feet raised above his waist. His feet must be visibly UP while his head and back are WAY DOWN. Two arms/hands, two legs/feet, correct connected elbows/knees, no impossible twist. Hands open with surprised embarrassed face, no cards flying. One retained small gold-trimmed black 100 card in image-left hand. No furniture or drawn floor.
Canvas and registration: square 2048x2048 transparent PNG. Use the SAME physical character scale as the attached master; don't make the skull larger just because the body is horizontal. The whole falling pose must fit between x512 and1536 with head/back near y1450-1530 and feet above that around y1050-1250. Leave minimum 25% clear transparent padding on all sides. No zoom or silhouette fitting. No enlarged head or extra-long limbs.
Style: exact crisp adult-cartoon master line work and flat restrained shading, no photorealism, no airbrush, no glow, no scene, no text labels, no grid. ONE complete lying-down figure only. Genuine transparent alpha.
